model.title: Dennis John Benigno Traumatic Brain Injury Program Reauthorization Act of 2026

summary.text: The bill would extend funding and authorization for the federal Traumatic Brain Injury program, which supports research, treatment, and services for people who have suffered traumatic brain injuries.
